purpose: Compare two no-fit fixed-domain prescribed-head boundary conductivity closures inside otherwise unchanged standard LARE D3/D4 dynamics against the qualified RS1-GW fine Reference histories.

reduced_model.internal_interface_closure: unchanged HE2021 Eq.24 adjacent fixed-layer extension used in DYN0A
reduced_model.coordinate: depth and bottom flux positive downward

CURRENT_LAYER_FACE.role: standard reduced-current-state face closure; no fitted coefficient

BOUNDARY_FACE.role: Dirichlet/source-structure sensitivity closure; no fitted coefficient and not claimed as an explicitly validated arbitrary-unsaturated-head He-2021 formula

reduced_model.explicitly_not_used: SWKIMPL=0 lagged K is Reference numerical time-level semantics and is not imported as the preferred physical LARE closure

forcing_semantics.initial_state: uniform Se0 after the already-qualified gravity-consistent seed; fixed-flux equilibrium is exact in the reduced source convention

numerical_floor.method: iterative Heun predictor-corrector, same source-anchored DYN0A implementation family
numerical_floor.domain: theta_r < theta_bar_i < theta_s and standard MvG branch psi>0.01 cm
refinement_report: max layer-storage difference between dt=0.0002 and 0.0001

reference_comparison.reference_storage: project the exact fine Reference theta profile onto the same D3/D4 bands at every accepted Stage-A step
reference_comparison.reference_bottom_exchange: BOTTOM_OUTWARD_EXCHANGE from the qualified Stage-A artifact, accumulated over intervals
reference_comparison.forbidden_observable_claim: Do not interpret Stage-A BOTTOM_FLUX as an independent current-K instantaneous Darcy-face observation.
primary_metrics: maximum absolute layer-storage error over time

adjudication.common_case_rule: Candidate comparison uses only partition/history cases qualified for both CURRENT_LAYER_FACE and BOUNDARY_FACE on the finest Heun route and backed by complete fine Reference data.
adjudication.relative_support_rule: A boundary candidate has relative support only if it is no worse than the other candidate on every primary maximum-error/sign/reversal component over the common cohort and strictly better on at least one. Otherwise close MIXED_NO_RELATIVE_SELECTION.
adjudication.D3_D4_interpretation: D4 improvement over D3 is closure-resolution evidence, not new state-information evidence.

pre_execution_domain_coverage_clarificat.rule: Relative support additionally requires the candidate to qualify at least as many preregistered partition/history cases as the comparator. A candidate with smaller errors only on a narrower surviving cohort cannot dominate.
pre_execution_domain_coverage_clarificat.blocked_vs_outside: OUTSIDE_QUALIFIED_DOMAIN and NUMERICAL_BLOCKED are reported separately and neither may be silently discarded.
pre_execution_domain_coverage_clarificat.scientific_effect: Adjudication clarification only; no candidate, forcing, numerical route, partition, or metric changed.
